title: Vanity Top Accessorie Toilet Tissue Holder, Solid Brass Countertop Stand, 6-Inch Height - | Mediterranean Blue | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade your bathroom vanity with a vanity top accessorie toilet tissue holder crafted from solid brass, designed for easy countertop placement when wall space is limited in Mediterranean Blue, which presents a deep, sophisticated blue with subtle purple undertones, evoking the rich depths of coastal waters for a bold yet refined statement.

  • Mediterranean Blue transforms this essential into a conversation piece
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Space-saving design: Keeps a roll within reach without wall mounting
  • Surface protection: Felt pad helps prevent scratching

Specs

  • Mounting type: Countertop
  • Dimensions: 5.5-Inch length x 5-Inch width x 6-Inch height
  • Weight: 4 lb
  • Assembly required: No
  • Included: Vanity Top Toilet Tissue Holder
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

Works well with modern bathroom hardware, contemporary bath accessories, and minimalist bathroom fixtures.
